fah-794.title: Four Juices: Strawberry, Banana, Melon & Mint Lemonade
fah-794.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-794.culturalNotes: Different lemons work — baladi or yellow. Garnish the glasses with fruit slices or fresh herbs.

instructions.1: Wash the strawberries and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the strawberries to the blender with the milk, whipping cream, ice cream, ice, and syrup, honey or sugar to taste.
instructions.3: Blend until smooth.
instructions.4: Pour into glasses and garnish with mint.
instructions.5: For the banana juice: cut the bananas into small pieces and add the ice, milk, honey, syrup or sugar, and vanilla.
instructions.6: Blend until smooth.
instructions.7: Pour into glasses and garnish with banana slices.
instructions.8: For the melon juice: cube the melon and add the sugar, milk and ice.
instructions.10: Pour into glasses and garnish with melon pieces.
instructions.11: For the lemonade: squeeze the lemons and remove the seeds.
instructions.12: Add the sugar and water and mix well.
instructions.14: Add the mint leaves and ice and blend once more.
instructions.15: Pour into glasses and garnish with lemon slices and mint.

fah-795.title: Iced White Mocha
fah-795.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-795.culturalNotes: Sweeten with sugar, honey or caramel syrup to taste.

instructions.1: Melt the white chocolate in the microwave for 30 seconds.
instructions.2: Mix the melted chocolate with the coffee dissolved in water.
instructions.3: Add the liquid vanilla to the mixture.
instructions.4: Put the mixture in the cup.
instructions.5: Fill the cup with ice.
instructions.6: Pour the milk over the mixture.
instructions.7: Add whipping cream and caramel syrup to taste.

fah-796.title: Cappuccino
fah-796.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-796.culturalNotes: Store the foam in an airtight container in the freezer so it lasts longer.

instructions.1: Mix the Nescafé, sugar and water in a cup.
instructions.2: Beat with an electric whisk for 5 minutes, starting on low speed and increasing gradually.
instructions.3: Keep whipping until you have a thick white foam.
instructions.4: Pour the foam into a clean, dry, airtight container.
instructions.5: Add the foam to a cup of hot milk with a spoonful of sugar if you like.
instructions.6: Garnish the cappuccino with a little grated cocoa on top.

fah-797.title: Foamy Nescafé
fah-797.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-797.culturalNotes: Serve with a small piece of chocolate or a biscuit to garnish.

instructions.1: Add a spoonful of Nescafé, a spoonful of sugar and a spoonful of water to a cup.
instructions.2: Whisk the mixture as shown until well blended.
instructions.3: Add the hot milk gradually to the mixture.
instructions.4: Stir vigorously to make the foam.
instructions.5: Dust a pinch of cocoa on top to garnish.

fah-798.title: Macchiato
fah-798.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-798.culturalNotes: Garnish with cream or chocolate pieces as you like. Macchiato also goes well with biscuits or a small cake.

instructions.1: Bring the milk to room temperature or take it out of the fridge a few minutes ahead.
instructions.2: Use a steam wand to heat the milk and make foam. Without one, use an electric or hand whisk to make the milk foamy.
instructions.3: Put the coarse ground coffee in a small cup.
instructions.4: Pour the milk foam over the coffee in the cup.
instructions.5: Add sugar to taste.
instructions.6: Serve hot.

fah-799.title: Delicious Doum Drink
fah-799.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-799.culturalNotes: Doum drink is cooling and healthy — it helps regulate blood pressure and cleanse the liver, kidneys and spleen. Serve cold on hot days.

instructions.1: Wash the doum well to remove any impurities or dust.
instructions.2: Put the sugar in a pot over the heat and stir it with the doum until it softens slightly, without colouring.
instructions.3: Add 2 litres of water and let the mixture heat without boiling.
instructions.4: Cover the pot, take it off the heat and leave it soaking in the fridge overnight.
instructions.5: Strain the drink well the next day.
instructions.6: You can store the drink in bags in the freezer to use as needed.

fah-800.title: Immunity Lemon, Ginger & Honey Drink
fah-800.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-800.culturalNotes: Take a spoonful of the mixture daily for immunity and glowing skin. It can also be stirred into hot water before drinking.

instructions.1: Peel the ginger as you would peel potatoes.
instructions.2: Wash the ginger and lemons well and dry them.
instructions.3: Slice the ginger and lemons.
instructions.4: Mix the ginger and lemons in a bowl.
instructions.5: Put the mixture in a jar.
instructions.6: Pour the honey over the mixture.
instructions.7: Cover the jar and refrigerate for two hours before using.
instructions.8: The mixture keeps in the fridge for a week.

fah-801.title: Glow Drink (Spinach, Beetroot & Strawberry)
fah-801.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-801.culturalNotes: Rich in vitamins and minerals — good for the skin and hair. Adjust the honey to taste.

instructions.1: Add the spinach leaves to the blender.
instructions.2: Add the strawberries.
instructions.3: Add the beetroot cut into small pieces.
instructions.4: Add the orange juice.
instructions.5: Add the white honey.
instructions.6: Add the water.
instructions.7: Blend everything together until smooth.

fah-802.title: Strawberry Mojito
fah-802.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-802.culturalNotes: Any other fruit works — berries or orange, for example.

instructions.1: Prepare the strawberries and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the strawberries to the glass with the sugar and lemon juice.
instructions.3: Add the hot water and stir until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Add ice as desired and stir once more.
instructions.5: Serve the drink cold in glasses.

fah-803.title: Prickly Pear Milkshake
fah-803.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-803.culturalNotes: Fresh or tinned prickly pear both work for the juice. Add a little sugar if you like it sweeter.

instructions.1: Wash the prickly pears well and peel them.
instructions.2: Cut the prickly pears into small pieces and add to the blender with a cup of water.
instructions.3: Blend the prickly pear and water well.
instructions.4: Strain the mixture to remove the seeds.
instructions.5: Keep about a litre and a half of the juice.
instructions.6: In the blender jug, add 3 cups of prickly pear juice, a cup of vanilla ice cream, the packet of whipping cream and a little ice.
instructions.7: Blend well until combined.
instructions.8: Pour the milkshake into glasses and serve cold.

fah-804.title: Coffee Milkshake
fah-804.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-804.culturalNotes: Any plain biscuits work if coffee biscuits aren't available. Add sugar if you like it sweeter.

instructions.1: Add the milk, Nescafé, coffee biscuits, cup of vanilla ice cream and crushed ice to the blender.
instructions.2: Blend everything well until combined.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into serving glasses.
instructions.4: Garnish with caramel sauce and raw whipping cream or vanilla ice cream.
instructions.5: Top each glass with a coffee biscuit or any plain biscuit.

fah-805.title: Mango Milkshake
fah-805.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-805.culturalNotes: Adjust the consistency with more ice or cold water. Garnish with berries or strawberries if you like.

instructions.1: Add the mango to the blender.
instructions.2: Add the ice cubes.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla ice cream.
instructions.4: Add the whipping cream.
instructions.5: Add the sugar.
instructions.6: Blend everything until smooth.
instructions.7: If it's too thick, add cold water or extra ice to reach the right consistency.
instructions.9: Garnish with a scoop of ice cream, mint leaves, mango cubes and a cherry.

fah-806.title: Oreo Milkshake
fah-806.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-806.culturalNotes: No extra sugar needed — the ice cream and Oreos are already sweet. Use chocolate sauce or any favourite sauce for flavour and looks.

instructions.1: Get the blender and add the ice cubes.
instructions.2: Add the vanilla ice cream.
instructions.3: Add the two cups of chilled milk.
instructions.4: Add the contents of the two Oreo packets.
instructions.5: Blend everything until combined.
instructions.6: Top with whipped cream or ice cream scoops as you like.
instructions.7: Garnish the glass with an Oreo biscuit or chocolate sauce.

fah-807.title: Nescafé with Cappuccino Foam
fah-807.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-807.culturalNotes: Keep the foam in a clean, airtight container in the freezer so it stays fresh longer.

instructions.1: Mix the Nescafé, sugar and water in a cup.
instructions.2: Beat with an electric whisk for 5 minutes, starting on low speed and increasing gradually.
instructions.3: Keep whipping until you have a thick white foam.
instructions.4: Store the foam in a clean, airtight container in the freezer.
instructions.5: To serve, add the foam to a cup of hot water or hot milk with sugar to taste.
instructions.6: Garnish with a little ground cocoa on top.

fah-808.title: Hot Chocolate with Marshmallows
fah-808.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-808.culturalNotes: Serve hot or cold as you like. Marshmallows on top make it look inviting.

instructions.1: Heat the kettle and add 2 cups of milk.
instructions.2: Add the two chocolate squares.
instructions.3: Stir until the chocolate melts.
instructions.4: Add 3 teaspoons of sugar to taste.
instructions.5: Leave the mixture until it boils and thickens.
instructions.6: Pour into cups and serve with marshmallows.

fah-242.title: Duqqa (Garlic & Pepper Relish)
fah-242.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-242.culturalNotes: Use the duqqa to marinate fish, stir into foul, or alongside pickles. It keeps for a long time in or out of the fridge.

instructions.1: Wash the peppers and garlic well and cut the peppers into small pieces.
instructions.2: Put the peppers and garlic in the food processor and grind well.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar, lemon juice, salt, dried coriander and cumin.
instructions.4: Blend everything in the processor until combined.
instructions.5: Put the duqqa in a clean, dry jar and keep it in or out of the fridge as you like.

fah-243.title: Pickled Potatoes
fah-243.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-243.culturalNotes: The salad keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve alongside breakfast, foul, ta'ameya or any other meal.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in boiling water for 3–4 minutes until half-cooked.
instructions.2: Drain and leave to cool slightly.
instructions.3: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small cubes.
instructions.4: Mix two tablespoons of the marinade (lemon, cumin, vinegar and garlic) with a tablespoon of oil and a teaspoon of turmeric.
instructions.5: Add the potato cubes to the marinade and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the minced garlic and minced parsley and mix together.
instructions.7: Serve the salad cold alongside any meal.

fah-244.title: Marinade for Fish & Poultry
fah-244.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-244.culturalNotes: Use this marinade to stuff aubergine or season fish and poultry. It keeps for a long time without refrigeration thanks to the salt and vinegar.

instructions.1: Blend the hot, sweet and red peppers with the vinegar, lemon, salt, coriander and cumin until the marinade is smooth.
instructions.2: Add the oil to the marinade and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the minced parsley and grated carrot and stir together.
instructions.4: Store the marinade in clean, dry jars in a cool, dry place.

fah-245.title: Toumeya (Hot Garlic Sauce)
fah-245.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-245.culturalNotes: Store the toumeya in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve it with grilled chicken, fried potatoes or spiced rice.

instructions.1: Mix 2 cups of water with 4 tablespoons of cornflour in a pot, stirring while cold.
instructions.2: Put the mixture over the heat, add the 7 garlic cloves and stir until the starch binds and turns translucent white.
instructions.3: Let the mixture cool slightly, then put it in the blender.
instructions.4: Add a cup of yogurt, half a cup of mayonnaise, a pinch of salt and 2 tablespoons of vinegar. Cover and blend well.
instructions.5: Add half a cup of oil gradually while the blender runs until the mixture is uniform.
instructions.6: Add 3 tablespoons of harissa and blend once more until fully combined.

fah-246.title: Pepper & Vinegar Duqqa
fah-246.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-246.culturalNotes: This mix works in many dishes — shawarma, tahini salad, baba ghanoush, fish marinades and pickled aubergine. It keeps in an airtight container without refrigeration.

instructions.1: Wash the green and red peppers well.
instructions.2: Remove the seeds and cut the peppers into large pieces.
instructions.3: Put the peppers in the food processor.
instructions.4: Add the peeled, prepared onion.
instructions.5: Add the vinegar and lemon juice.
instructions.6: Add the cumin, coriander and salt.
instructions.7: Cover the processor and grind everything well.
instructions.8: Transfer the mix to a suitable storage container.

fah-247.title: Pepper & Coriander Duqqa
fah-247.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-247.culturalNotes: Use this duqqa to marinate fish, shrimp, aubergine and more. It keeps for a month outside the fridge.

instructions.1: Wash the hot and sweet peppers and the red and green peppers well.
instructions.2: Cut the peppers, fresh coriander and garlic into small pieces.
instructions.3: Mix everything in a deep bowl.
instructions.4: Add the vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cumin, dried coriander and chilli.
instructions.5: Blend the mixture well until combined.
instructions.6: Store the duqqa in an airtight container in or out of the fridge for a month.

fah-248.title: Parsley & Onion Salad
fah-248.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-248.culturalNotes: Add olives or fatta croutons for variety. The salad keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Chop the parsley finely.
instructions.2: Slice the onions thinly.
instructions.3: Cut the cucumber into small pieces.
instructions.4: Cut the tomatoes into medium pieces.
instructions.5: Put all the ingredients in a serving dish.
instructions.6: Add the salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, paprika and chilli to taste.
instructions.7: Toss the ingredients well.
instructions.8: Add the lemon juice and water and toss once more.
instructions.9: Serve cold with kofta and fried potatoes.

fah-249.title: Tuna Salad
fah-249.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-249.culturalNotes: Add hot pepper or green bell pepper to taste. Serve the tuna salad on toast or in sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mash the tuna well in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the coloured peppers cut into small cubes.
instructions.3: Add the onion cut into small pieces.
instructions.4: Add 4 tablespoons of sweetcorn (optional).
instructions.5: Add a pinch of salt.
instructions.6: Add the juice of the two lemons.
instructions.7: Mix everything together well.
instructions.9: Mix once more until well combined.

fah-250.title: Grill-Style Salad (Salatit el-Hati)
fah-250.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-250.culturalNotes: Add ice cubes to make it cooler and more refreshing. Serve with grilled chicken or pasta with tomato sauce.

instructions.1: Cut the red onion into small pieces and put it in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the cumin, black pepper, dried coriander, salt, lemon juice, vinegar and ground pepper. Mix well.
instructions.3: Cut the cucumber, tomatoes, bell pepper and hot chilli into small pieces and add to the bowl.
instructions.4: Grate the carrot and add it to the bowl.
instructions.5: Add the dill, parsley and fresh coriander. Mix everything well.
instructions.6: Serve in a salad dish.

fah-251.title: Renga (Herring) Salad
fah-251.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-251.culturalNotes: Renga salad works as a light meal or part of a holiday spread. The dressing keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the tahini with a quarter cup of water and beat well.
instructions.2: Add the mayonnaise, lemon juice, vinegar, chilli, cumin and salt. Beat together.
instructions.3: Add the white onion cut into thin slices, the green and red peppers and the parsley. Mix well.
instructions.4: Add the cubed renga over the salad and toss together.
instructions.5: Garnish the dish with renga pieces, a renga rose and cherry tomatoes.
instructions.6: Add the boiled or fried potato cubes and cubed renga, and toss together.
instructions.7: Mix the tahini with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, oil and cream. Beat well.
instructions.8: Add the spring onions, pepper and dill. Mix together.
instructions.9: Garnish the dish with boiled potato slices, spring onions, dill and a lemon slice.
instructions.10: Boil water and add the renga for a minute until the skin loosens and the saltiness eases.
instructions.11: Peel the renga and remove the bones and innards.
instructions.12: Toss the renga with the lemon juice, tahini, crushed pepper and oil.

fah-252.title: Yogurt Salad (with Rice & Fall-Apart Chicken)
fah-252.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-252.culturalNotes: Add ground black pepper for more bite. The salad keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Cut the cucumbers into small cubes.
instructions.2: Crush the garlic well.
instructions.3: Cut the mint leaves into small pieces.
instructions.4: Mix all the ingredients in a deep dish.
instructions.5: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise, salt and lemon juice.
instructions.6: Stir until combined.
instructions.7: Serve the salad alongside the rice and fall-apart chicken.

fah-253.title: Harsha Salad (Spicy Chopped Salad)
fah-253.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-253.culturalNotes: Add grated carrot or chopped cucumber for more flavour and nutrition. The salad keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Cut the red onions into small cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the tomatoes, red pepper and green pepper into small cubes.
instructions.3: Chop the parsley and coriander into small pieces.
instructions.4: Slice the garlic thinly.
instructions.5: Mix everything in a large bowl.
instructions.6: Add the vinegar and lemon juice and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the salt, black pepper, cumin, chilli and pomegranate molasses and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the olive oil and stir together.
instructions.9: Serve cold as a side dish or light meal.

fah-254.title: Sweet & Chilli Sauce
fah-254.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-254.culturalNotes: This sauce goes with grills, roasts and fried dishes. It keeps in the fridge for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Wash the hot red peppers and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Put the peppers, sugar, vinegar and salt in a pot and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the water and leave the mixture over medium heat until it boils.
instructions.4: In a small bowl, mix the cornflour with 4 cups of water until smooth.
instructions.5: Add the cornflour mixture gradually to the boiling mixture, stirring until it thickens.
instructions.6: Add the black honey (molasses) and tomato sauce and stir until combined.
instructions.7: Leave the mixture over the heat for another 5 minutes until thick.
instructions.8: Pour it into a container and leave to cool before refrigerating.

fah-255.title: Sweet Chilli Sauce
fah-255.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-255.culturalNotes: Serve the sauce with roasted potatoes, pané and sandwiches. Adjust the heat to taste.

instructions.1: Wash the hot red peppers and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Put the hot red peppers, garlic powder, onion powder and ginger powder in the blender and grind well.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of water to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into a pot over the heat and add half a cup of vinegar, half a cup of sugar, two tablespoons of tomato sauce, two tablespoons of black honey, the salt and ground black pepper. Mix well.
instructions.5: Add the remaining cup of water and leave the mixture to boil.
instructions.6: In a small bowl, mix two tablespoons of cornflour with the remaining half cup of water.
instructions.7: Add the cornflour mixture to the pot and stir until the consistency thickens.
instructions.8: Leave the sauce to cool completely.
instructions.9: Pour the sauce into a clean, dry jar and keep in the fridge for one to two months.

fah-256.title: Shateeta with Grilled Aubergine
fah-256.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-256.culturalNotes: Serve the shateeta as a dip, salad or side dish with foul, ta'ameya, fried potatoes or boiled eggs. It also goes with koshari or a grill spread.

instructions.1: Wash the aubergine, dry it and make slits in it with a knife.
instructions.2: Grill the aubergine over the fire on all sides over medium heat.
instructions.3: Wash the red and green peppers and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat, add the garlic and sauté until lightly coloured.
instructions.5: Add the peppers and sauté with the garlic until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the tomatoes cut into small cubes and the spices (cumin, coriander, salt) and stir together.
instructions.7: Add the vinegar and honey and leave the mixture to boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: Squeeze the lemon and add its juice to the mixture.
instructions.10: Peel the grilled aubergine easily — wrap it in cling film without covering the base while hot.
instructions.11: Add the grilled aubergine to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.12: Add a splash of olive oil and the fresh coriander or parsley.

fah-257.title: Shalloulou (Upper Egyptian Molokhia Salad)
fah-257.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-257.culturalNotes: Add chilli for those who like it hot. Serve shalloulou as a starter or side dish.

instructions.1: Peel the garlic and mince it — about a tablespoon.
instructions.2: Get a teaspoon of cumin and a teaspoon of dried coriander.
instructions.3: Mince the hot green pepper.
instructions.4: Mix the garlic, cumin, coriander and hot pepper in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add the grated tomatoes and lemon and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the dried molokhia and stir together.
instructions.7: Add the water and stir until it reaches the right consistency.
instructions.8: Taste and add salt as needed.
instructions.9: Serve the shalloulou in a dish with fresh onion rings, hot peppers and lemon slices.

fah-258.title: Everyday Tomato Sauce
fah-258.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-258.culturalNotes: The sauce keeps in plastic bags in the fridge for a week or the freezer for a month.

instructions.1: Prepare the tomatoes: juice them and strain well.
instructions.2: Fry the garlic and onion.
instructions.3: Add the strained tomatoes and stir with the onion and garlic.
instructions.4: Add the salt and sugar and stir well.
instructions.5: Leave the sauce over low heat with the lid half-covered to let steam out.
instructions.6: Add the spices (cumin, coriander, black pepper) and the 3 stock cubes.
instructions.7: Leave the sauce to boil for about 10 minutes until combined.
instructions.8: Add the sauce to dishes as needed.

fah-259.title: Koshari Sauce
fah-259.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-259.culturalNotes: The sauce keeps in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week. Use it for koshari or pasta.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the garlic and fry until golden.
instructions.3: Add the onion and stir until pale yellow.
instructions.4: Add the strained tomato juice and stir with the onion and garlic.
instructions.5: Add the salt and sugar and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the cumin, coriander and black pepper and stir into the sauce.
instructions.7: Add the stock cubes and stir well.
instructions.8: Leave the sauce over low heat with the lid half-covered to stop splattering.
instructions.9: Leave it to boil for 10 minutes until combined.
instructions.10: Turn off the heat and leave the sauce to cool slightly before using.

fah-260.title: Pasta Sauce
fah-260.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-260.culturalNotes: The sauce keeps in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week. Use it for pasta, koshari and other dishes.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the onion and stir until pale yellow.
instructions.4: Add the tomato juice and stir well with the onion and garlic.
instructions.5: Add the salt and sugar and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the cumin, coriander and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the stock cubes and stir well.
instructions.8: Leave the sauce over low heat with the lid half-covered to stop splattering.
instructions.9: Leave it to boil for 10 minutes until combined.
instructions.10: Turn off the heat and leave the sauce to cool slightly before using.

fah-261.title: Barbecue Sauce
fah-261.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-261.culturalNotes: The sauce keeps in an airtight container in the fridge for up to two weeks. Use it with grills or as a sauce for chicken and meat.

instructions.1: Put half a cup of water in a pot over the heat.
instructions.2: Add 2 cups of ketchup to the water and stir.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of vinegar, a quarter cup of sugar and a tablespoon of black honey.
instructions.4: Add a teaspoon of turmeric, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper and salt.
instructions.5: Add two tablespoons of smoked paprika and stir well.
instructions.6: Add a tablespoon of soy sauce and stir.
instructions.7: Leave the mixture to boil over the heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
instructions.8: Take the mixture off the heat and leave to cool.

fah-262.title: Creamy Mushroom Sauce
fah-262.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-262.culturalNotes: Fresh or tinned mushrooms both work. Season to taste.

instructions.1: Melt the ghee or butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the flour and stir until toasted and golden.
instructions.3: Add a pinch of black pepper and stir.
instructions.4: Add the drained mushrooms and stir over the heat for a few minutes until softened.
instructions.5: Add the meat gravy and stir until combined.
instructions.6: Add the cooking cream and stir until the consistency is creamy.
instructions.7: Leave the sauce over the heat until it thickens slightly.

fah-263.title: Ranch Sauce
fah-263.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-263.culturalNotes: The sauce keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days. Use it for sandwiches, salads or as a vegetable dip.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt and mayonnaise in a deep bowl.
instructions.2: Add the lemon juice and finely chopped dill.
instructions.3: Add a pinch of onion powder, garlic powder, ginger and black pepper.
instructions.4: Stir well until combined.
instructions.5: Add a tablespoon of mustard and stir once more.
instructions.6: Mix the sauce well and serve cold.

fah-264.title: Sweet Chilli Sauce
fah-264.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-264.culturalNotes: The sauce keeps in an airtight container in the fridge for up to two weeks. Serve with grills or as a sauce for chicken and meat.

instructions.1: Add the water, sugar and vinegar to a pan and stir well.
instructions.2: Add the crushed chilli and the finely chopped garlic and stir together.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of ketchup and stir well.
instructions.4: Put the mixture over medium heat and leave to boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Add the salt and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the cornflour dissolved in water and stir quickly until combined.
instructions.7: Leave the mixture over the heat until it binds and thickens.
instructions.8: Take it off the heat and leave to cool.

fah-265.title: Homemade Egg-Free Mayonnaise
fah-265.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-265.culturalNotes: Use this mayonnaise in salads, pastries and other dishes. It keeps in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week.

instructions.1: Add the triangle cheese to the cold milk in the blender jug.
instructions.2: Add the mustard and salt and blend well.
instructions.3: Add the lemon juice and blend once more.
instructions.4: Add the vegetable oil gradually in a thin stream while the blender runs.
instructions.5: Add the vinegar and blend well.
instructions.6: Add the white honey and keep blending until the mixture is uniform and thick.

fah-187.title: Yellow Rice
fah-187.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-187.culturalNotes: Use instant stock if you don't have fresh meat broth. Toast the nuts before adding for stronger flavour.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the rice and stir for a minute until coated in oil.
instructions.3: Add the turmeric, black pepper and salt and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the broth and water and stir well.
instructions.5: Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and cover the pot.
instructions.6: Leave the rice to cook for 15–20 minutes until done.
instructions.7: When time is up, rest the rice for 5 minutes then fluff gently.
instructions.8: Serve topped with nuts and coriander or parsley to taste.
